title: an ode to onions
body:
at this point in time you've reached
legendary status
living beings compare themselves to you
like shrek
books that everyone's read worship you and
place you on God's Thumb
news articles use your name to piggyback
off your fame
the french honor you as a third of mirepoix
and they certainly know how to cook

you show us unity
so when i tear through your layers with steel i
cry as it divides you the way its divided us
around the globe

every time i encounter your bleeding pungency
i pay my respects
to the whole you once were
and with every bite, i sink my teeth into
concentric eternity
